newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt had prior interest in Nat'l Education.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt had prior interest in Nat'l Education.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc, which earlier launched a $740 million tender offer for National Eduction Corp, said it had previously expressed interest in the company.

In a letter to National Education chief executive Sam Yau, Harcourt also said it conducted an intensive strategic review of the company after National Education last month announced a merger agreement with Sylvan Learning Systems Inc.
The review indicated that "the strategic and financial advantages of combining our two companies are too compelling to ignore," wrote Harcourt chief executive officer Richard Smith in the letter.
The letter was made available by Harcourt.
Smith also said that Harcourt would prefer a negotiated agreement with National Education, but said it launched the tender offer "to underscore the seriousness of our intentions".
Smith also urged Yau to make available information that had been provided to Sylvan.
The letter did not disclose details of the prior interest that had been expressed by Harcourt.
National Education could not be reached for comment.
